name: Oncogenic membrane-tethered receptor tyrosine kinase fusions and ALK family
rationale: All members are cancer-driving RTK variants (PDGFR/FGFR1-3 membrane-bound fusions, LTK, TKI-bound ALK mutants), distinguished from confusables that hold EGFR/ERBB2 point mutants, amplifications or cytosolic fusions.

name: Myeloid lineage differentiation under RUNX transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover granulocyte, monocyte, mast cell, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and the RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional programs that drive them, unlike confusables centred on stem-cell homeostasis, erythrocyte maturation or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

name: Phagocyte respiratory burst and Leishmania-induced anti-inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members combine NADPH oxidase superoxide generation in phagocytes with the cAMP-linked anti-inflammatory macrophage responses (IL10, CD163, ADORA2B, purinergic, anthrax toxin) exploited in Leishmania infection, which the neutrophil-degranulation and ROS-catabolism confusables lack.

core: Cell-cell junction assembly and epithelial polarity
name: Adherens, desmosome and hemidesmosome junctions with epithelial polarity
rationale: Members concern cadherin-based adherens junctions, desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate-filament anchoring and apical/basal polarity, whereas confusables lack the desmosome/hemidesmosome and CDH1 turnover members and instead carry negative regulation of adhesion and EMT.

name: Renal proximal tubule organic ion, urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic anion/cation, urate and cystine transport and their renal diseases (cystinuria, hypouricemia) in the proximal tubule, distinct from confusables dominated by amino acid and peptide transporters.

qualifier: SREBP feedback on synthesis and uptake
name: SREBP-mediated sterol feedback on cholesterol synthesis and uptake
rationale: Members describe sterol sensing via SREBP that tunes cholesterol biosynthesis and receptor-mediated uptake, while confusables concern LXR-driven efflux, reverse cholesterol transport and lipoprotein receptor turnover.

qualifier: suppression of end joining and recombination
name: Telomere capping and suppression of end joining and recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging and protection from NHEJ and recombination, distinct from confusables about telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis or telomere replication.

core: Vascular tone and blood pressure regulation
name: Endothelial NO-cGMP signaling in vascular tone and blood pressure
rationale: Members link eNOS activation, trafficking and NO-cGMP signaling to vascular smooth muscle relaxation and arterial pressure, which confusables share only in their smooth-muscle and renal parts and not the eNOS members.

name: Palmitoylation and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog morphogens
rationale: Members cover cysteine palmitoylation by PORCN and HHAT and the release of Wnt and Hedgehog ligands, unlike confusables about prenylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing or downstream Hedgehog signaling.

core: Bile acid metabolism and hepatobiliary transport
name: Bile acid metabolism and hepatobiliary bilirubin and drug transport
rationale: Members span bile acid synthesis and transport, canalicular ABC and SLCO transporter defects, bilirubin glucuronidation and drug ADME, distinguishing them from confusables on lipoprotein/lipid absorption or phase I-II xenobiotic metabolism.

name: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion and repair synthesis
rationale: Members describe recombination-based repair steps (strand invasion, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, interstrand cross-link repair, repair DNA synthesis), distinct from confusables on NHEJ, BRCA1/2 damage signaling, Fanconi anemia or telomere/fork processes.

core: Iron acquisition at the host-pathogen interface
name: Host-pathogen iron competition, neutrophil granules and oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members combine iron import and pathogen iron/heme assimilation with neutrophil antimicrobial granule programs and proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport, while confusables cover systemic iron, heme and transferrin handling without the phagocyte components.

name: Telomere end protection, C-strand replication and recombination control
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, protection from NHEJ/recombination, t-circle and D-loop control and C-strand lagging synthesis, distinct from confusables on telomerase extension or general replication-fork and repair processes.

name: Bile acid sensing, feedback regulation and enterohepatic recycling
rationale: Members concern bile acid signaling, LXR-mediated feedback on synthesis, transport and recycling, while confusables hold bile acid synthesis routes or intestinal lipid absorption.

name: AP-1-driven immediate-early growth factor and inflammatory response
rationale: Members are AP-1/FOSL/NR4A immediate-early gene programs induced by growth factors, KRAS and TNF-NF-kB, including monocyte chemokine signaling, unlike confusables on MAPK feedback, UV stress or mRNA decay.

name: Sleep-wake arousal with feeding and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members regulate sleep/wake states, feeding and locomotor rhythm, including orexin signaling, whereas confusables cover HPA stress responses, other neuropeptide behaviors or hormonal appetite control without sleep.

name: Smooth muscle contraction-relaxation and cGMP control of blood pressure
rationale: Members cover vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation, cGMP synthesis and effects and their impact on arterial pressure and natriuresis, distinct from confusables built on eNOS activation or renin-angiotensin.

qualifier: 12-LOX hepoxilins and epidermal fatty acid defects
name: 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin synthesis and epidermal fatty acid metabolism
rationale: Members describe 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin and linoleate oxidation together with epidermal fatty acid handling defects causing ichthyosis, separating them from P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase, 5/15-LOX lipoxin and cornification confusables.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation plus mitochondrial RNA processing and mitoribosome subunit assembly, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation, nuclear tRNA processing or RNA import.

name: Nutrient starvation-induced autophagy, nucleophagy and ATG8 delipidation
rationale: The three members are autophagy-linked responses to nitrogen limitation, ATG8 deconjugation and piecemeal nucleophagy, distinct from confusables on autophagosome assembly, lysosome fusion or protein prenylation.

name: Cardiac action potential depolarization, repolarization and pacemaker channels
rationale: Members span all action potential phases, K+ (Kir, TWIK, voltage-gated) and HCN channels and conduction-system signaling, while confusables center on gap-junction coupling or calcium-channel regulation.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance and LXR-regulated triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members cover VLDL/chylomicron remodeling and clearance by LPL/LIPC and LXR control of lipogenesis and lipolysis, unlike confusables centred on HDL/LDL remodeling and intestinal lipid absorption.

name: Copper and manganese ion transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern copper and manganese import, transport, detoxification and ceruloplasmin defects, distinct from zinc, iron/heme and metallothionein confusables.

name: Renal salt-water balance and cellular osmotic regulation
rationale: Members cover renal Na+/K+/Cl-/Mg2+ transport, cation-chloride cotransporter defects, vasopressin-aquaporin water reabsorption and cellular osmotic stress responses, distinct from renin-angiotensin, K+ channel and glycerol/urea transport confusables.

qualifier: notochord and floor plate in neural patterning
name: Notochord-floor plate midline formation in early neural patterning
rationale: Members describe axial mesoderm/notochord and ventral midline/floor plate formation with neural plate regionalization and fold formation, whereas confusables cover neural plate border, left-right asymmetry or spinal cord neuron specification.
